_comment: On-server explicit-image check (DEC-133). An int8 ONNX export of Falconsai/nsfw_image_detection (ViT-base, classes normal/nsfw). Chosen over NudeNet, whose repository is AGPL-3.0. Runs before an upload is stored; scores 0.000-0.005 on every ordinary test photograph.
name: NSFW image classifier (ViT, ONNX int8)
redistribution_notes: Apache-2.0 (base model Falconsai/nsfw_image_detection). Suitable for commercial use.
